item.title: A flat headache: Why England flats have no takers despite price cuts
item.summary: In the current market, English flat owners are facing significant challenges in selling their properties, with many listings lingering for months. Frequent price reductions and failed deals lead to decreasing valuations, while leasehold issues and mismatched price expectations between buyers and investors create additional obstacles. The tightening of mortgage lending conditions and surveyor downvaluations complicate the situation further, leaving small landlords grappling with unsold properties and growing complexities.
